Team —

We have Samir Kapoor (Senior Infra PM) lined up for a virtual onsite the week of June 7. Aisha confirmed the candidate prefers mornings PT. Proposed structure below (60–75 minute slots):

- 09:00–10:15 PT: System design + infra tradeoffs (lead: Laura)
- 10:30–11:15 PT: Product + cross-team (lead: Logan)
- 11:30–12:15 PT: Leadership + culture fit (lead: Marissa)

Notes / asks:
- Buffer windows: 15 minutes between slots for quick breaks and notes.
- Warmup protocol: join 10 minutes early for tech check, call host will be Laura.
- Fallback plan: if any interviewer is blocked last-minute, we should pivot to the backup panel cascade (see below).

Backup cascade (in order): Laura -> Tessa -> Logan. Tessa can take SysDesign if Laura drops, Logan can expand his slot if needed.
